Belgrave Harriers’ Life Member George Piddington passed away on Thursday, 22nd December. He has been described as the archetypal chirpy cockney, who lived life to the full.

Back in February 1995, George Piddington had collapsed of a major heart attack and we summarised his life and achievements in the Belgravian, whilst ending our piece with the rallying cry of “Come on George, pull through, we’re all thinking of you.” Perhaps he heard our plea as he did pull through for another 11 years.
